title: Ha Tien Du Episode 2: The Black Serpent's Touch
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic

concept.hook: The manual requires sacrifice — blood for every breakthrough.
concept.story_arc: Desperate training → First meridian opens → Pain beyond想象 → Black veins appear → Hidden strength
concept.emotion: Desperation → Agony → Shock → Acceptance → Dark power

shots.prompt: Extreme wide shot — deep in a forest at night. The young man stands barefoot on a mossy boulder in a stream. His hands are cut, blood dripping onto the pages of the Black Serpent Manual. Rain pours down. He reads by a small fire's glow. Camera: extreme wide establishing shot, slow zoom in through the trees. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Tracking zoom — extreme wide through forest to the solitary figure, 6s
shots.narration: For three months, he trained in secret. Every night. Every dawn.
shots.sfx: Rain on leaves, stream flowing, fire crackling, page turning

shots.prompt: Close-up — his face contorted in extreme pain. His hands are pressed against a tree trunk, fingers digging into bark. Dark veins begin to appear on his forearm — black, pulsing, spreading. He grits his teeth. Blood drips from his nose. His eyes flash with dark energy. Camera: close-up on face, then quick cut to black veins spreading up his arm. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — face pain, then cut to black veins spreading, 6s
shots.narration: The Black Serpent path was not gentle. It demanded blood. It demanded pain.
shots.sfx: Bones cracking, intense breathing, dark wind howling, heartbeat intensifying

shots.prompt: Medium wide shot — he collapses onto the forest floor, gasping. Black veins pulse visibly on his skin, glowing faintly. His entire body shakes. He looks at his hands — trembling, but different. Stronger. Dark energy swirls around his palms. Camera: wide shot from above, looking down at his prone figure, dark energy visible. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Bird's-eye wide shot — his collapsed body, dark energy rising, 6s
shots.narration: But when the pain faded — something awakened inside him. Something the sect had never seen.
shots.sfx: Breathing slowing, dark energy crackling, wind settling, mysterious hum

shots.prompt: Close-up — he raises one trembling hand toward the camera. Black energy spirals around his fingers — pure black, smoky, alive. His eyes glow faintly with dark power. His lips form a grim smile. He clenches his fist. The black energy solidifies into a serpentine shadow that coils once around his arm then dissipates. Camera: close-up extreme on hand with black energy, then his smiling face. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up — black energy swirling, then his dark smile, 6s
shots.narration: One meridian opened. The sect called it worthless. They had no idea what it truly meant.
shots.sfx: Energy crackling, dark wind, his quiet laugh, serpent hiss

shots.prompt: Wide shot — he stands in the forest clearing, now calm. Rain has stopped. The first light of dawn breaks through clouds, illuminating his figure from behind. His torn gray robe billows in a sudden wind. His back is straight. He looks toward the distant sect peaks. Camera: wide shot from behind, dawn light silhouette, looking toward the sect. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide shot from behind — dawn silhouette, powerful stance, 6s
shots.narration: They thought they were discarding trash. They were forging a weapon.
shots.sfx: Wind rising, distant morning bells from the sect, dramatic orchestral swell
